releases.name: Jira Workflow Guard v1.0.0
releases.body:
Jira Workflow Guard 1.0.0

Installable Codex plugin with three bundled skills: Jira workflow, Ponytail, and ShopIL project context.

- Per-installer ownership: authenticated Jira accountId must exactly match the ticket assignee before updates. Unassigned and other users' tasks are read-only. No task creation unless explicitly requested.
- Conventional Commits, ticket-scoped feature branches, local Git hooks, PR checks, and a trusted-base CI template.
- 15 original course files, 13 searchable extracts, complete lecturer ETL/Streaming archives, source hashes, requirements and Jira task mapping.
- 25 passing tests on Ubuntu and Windows, Python 3.11 and 3.13. Tests include actual Git hooks, ownership/account-switch cases, package integrity, and reproducible packaging.

Install:

```sh
codex plugin marketplace add eldarush/jira-workflow-guard --ref v1.0.0
codex plugin add jira-workflow-guard@eldarush-workflows
```

Connect Atlassian with your own account. Plugin installation does not alter implementation repositories; use the included setup guide to activate checks. The separate ShopIL repository remains empty.

The attached ZIP is the portable plugin package; its SHA-256 checksum is attached separately. Original plugin code is MIT; bundled course materials retain their third-party rights. Instructor solutions are reference-only.

Limits: local hooks and skills are not a security sandbox. Live Jira reads and server-side permissions are needed for authoritative ownership; a skill cannot atomically prevent concurrent reassignment. CI validates this plugin, not the ShopIL application. This is a GitHub release, not a listing in OpenAI's universal plugin directory.

issues_and_prs.title: feat: add Jira workflow guard and ShopIL course kit [SHOPIL-47]
issues_and_prs.body:
## Summary

Build an installable Codex plugin for [SHOPIL-47](https://privaterelay-team-yb37vjhl.atlassian.net/browse/SHOPIL-47), with a reusable Jira workflow and the ShopIL source kit.

- Resolve the authenticated Jira accountId and require exact assignee equality before writes. Unassigned/other users' issues remain read-only; never create tasks without an explicit request.
- Bundle Ponytail, branch/Conventional Commit/PR checks, safe local hook installation, and a downstream CI template that reads policy from the trusted base.
- Include 15 source originals, 13 text extracts, complete lecturer lab archives, attribution, requirements and task mapping.
- Package a deterministic release ZIP and checksum.

## Validation

- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`: 25 passing tests locally, including real Git hooks, ownership/account-switch checks, invalid PR/commit rejection, original-file hashes, archive integrity and deterministic packaging.
- All three skills pass the Skill Creator validator.
- `codex plugin list --marketplace eldarush-workflows --available --json` discovers version 1.0.0.
- GitHub CI runs the same suite and package build on Ubuntu/Windows with Python 3.11/3.13, plus PR convention checks.

## Limits

Skills and local hooks are not a security boundary. Jira snapshots need fresh connector reads and cannot atomically lock ownership; server-side Jira permissions are needed for a hard guarantee. Branch protection is configured separately. These checks do not validate the ShopIL application or live LLM behavior. Third-party course material retains its original rights. The separate ShopIL application repository remains empty.
